learnings: A function that only prints gives its caller `None`, so nothing can build on it.
Keep a pure core (returns data) and a thin shell (prints, writes files, sends email).
Returned values are trivially testable; printed text needs capturing.
pitfalls: Discounts above 100 % produced negative invoices until the input was validated.
next: Apply the pure-core/thin-shell split to the CLI capstone on Day 83.
